title: Triton & Sea Haven
meta_description: Steps from the beach, Triton \& Sea Haven offer two chic condos with a pool, hot tub \& room for 15---your Emerald Coast escape starts here.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Triton \& Sea Haven by AvantStay! These two condos are located in the same building, with a combined total of 4 bedrooms, sleeping 15 guests---an ideal option for family trips or groups looking to spread out.

Just a 3-minute stroll from the sugar-white sand beaches, Triton \& Sea Haven are your gateway to a quintessential Emerald Coast escape. You'll also be only 10 minutes from the coveted Alys Beach for easy access to shopping, dining, and exploring.

Welcome to Triton! Step inside to find a bright, airy interior that instantly feels like home. The living room flows seamlessly into a chic dining area with seating for six, perfect for shared meals and laughter-filled evenings. The fully equipped kitchen, complete with modern appliances and ample counter space, makes meal prep a breeze. The primary bedroom is a haven of comfort with a king-sized bed, a private TV, and an ensuite bathroom for ultimate convenience. The second bedroom is designed for flexibility, featuring a queen bed and a twin-over-twin bunk bed, making it ideal for families or groups. Outside, your private balcony overlooks the sparkling communal pool and hot tub, where you can cool off or unwind. Enjoy al fresco dining with the gentle ocean breeze as your soundtrack, making every meal a memorable experience.

Escape to Sea Haven! Live in luxury as you step into the newly renovated, 2BDR 2BR condo. Natural light fills the space, and complements the stylish decor, creating an elegant yet rustic ambiance. With laundry in unit, a fully equipped kitchen, and additions like the built-in WiFi speaker systems, comfort and convenience are guaranteed during your stay. The primary bedroom boasts a king bed and private ensuite bathroom, while the second bedroom has a twin-over-queen bunk bed, ideal for families. Two sleeping sofas in the living room---one queen and one full---provide additional sleeping space. The balcony provides the perfect outdoor space to enjoy from morning till night. Barstool seating lines the counter, so you can catch the ocean breeze while you sit and enjoy your morning coffee. Adorned with tall Adirondack chairs and string lights, the space seamlessly transforms into an evening oasis. Kick back and feel your stress melt away as you watch the sunset paint the sky with color.

Triton \& Sea Haven offer ample resort-style amenities at your fingertips. The pool area is complemented with a hot tub, poolside lounge chairs for tanning, and a spacious shaded cabana with plenty of seating. Nearby grills and picnic tables complete the outdoor experience, and invite you to end the night with an ideal BBQ setup. When you've had plenty of pool time, head down to the beach and enjoy the waves.

Whether you're here for a week or a weekend, this is more than just a place to stay---it's your ticket to an unforgettable beach vacation.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure views, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Camp Helen State Park, Ms. Newby's and Runaway Island (karaoke), Jimmy Buffett's Margaritaville, Pier Park, Gulf World Marine Park, Water Planet, Little Village Waterfront Shopping Market, SkyWheel, Shipwreck Island Waterpark.

Home Truths:
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- The communal pool is not heated.

Parking Details:
- Each unit has onsite parking for 2 cars.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
